sources.role: primary/latest uploaded schema and Supabase migration source

important_notes: Canonical migration filenames were normalized for deterministic ordering; SQL bodies are preserved with a source header.
The root master_deploy.sql is for psql, not Supabase SQL Editor, because it uses psql \i includes.
Supabase managed auth/storage schemas are referenced, not recreated wholesale.
Create the founder Auth user first, then run the founder admin seed template if needed.
Original migration files are preserved under original_migrations for auditability.
